beats_top.why: The #1 result is Cornell's Bursar list of nine banks with phone numbers only, with no fees, SSN rules, ATM networks or steps. Our page answers in the first paragraph, compares published fees and SSN rules, and gives a checklist and direct-deposit deadline.
